content_sections.heading: KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Document Verification is scheduled post-wise as follows. Registration on the day of Document Verification is only between 9:00 AM and 12:00 PM. The notification does not specify a separate NATS portal registration deadline; candidates must have a valid, approved NATS ID at the time of Document Verification.

content_sections.heading: KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 134 Apprentice Trainee slots are available across nine post categories under Medical Category B1 (engineering posts) and C1 (General Stream Graduates).

content_sections.heading: KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed out during 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 (within the last 5 years from the date of passing the qualifying exam and date of joining training). Qualification requirements by category: Category I – Graduate Apprentices (Engineering): BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics & Power Engineering (or a combination of basic Electrical sub-streams) for Electrical Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science & Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering (or a combination of these basic streams) for Electronics Engineering; or Mechanical/Industrial/Automobile/Production Engineering for Mechanical Engineering - from an AICTE-recognized university. Category II – Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Diploma in Civil Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics & Power Engineering (or a combination of basic streams) for Electrical; or Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science & Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering (or a combination) for Electronics; or Mechanical/Industrial/Automobile/Production Engineering for Mechanical - from a University or Institution recognized by the Central/State Govt. Technical Education Board or University. Category III – Graduate Apprentices (General Stream): Bachelor of Arts / Science / Commerce / Business Administration / Management Science / Journalism and Mass Communication / Business Studies from a UGC or Central/State Govt./Technical Education Board recognized University or Institute. No additional weightage is given for a higher qualification than the minimum prescribed. Candidates who have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act, 1973 in any Government/PSU/Private Industrial Organization are not eligible. Age Limit: 18 to 25 years as on 1 January 2026 (date of birth between 1 January 2001 and 1 January 2008). Age relaxation is subject to submission of the required documents at the time of Document Verification. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying. Candidates must meet the minimum physical fitness standards prescribed in the notification and must bring a medical certificate, in the prescribed Apprentice Act, 1961 format, certified by a Government Doctor not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon of the Central/State Medical Services, at the time of Document Verification. Final medical fitness is certified by KRCL's Medical Authority, and the cost of the medical examination is borne by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: KRCL Apprentice Trainee Stipend
content_sections.text: Stipend is paid through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism, combining the Government of India's DBT share and KRCL's establishment share. Candidates must have a bank account in their own name and a PAN card to receive the stipend, and must retain the same Aadhaar-linked bank account until training completion. Candidates must also make their own lodging and boarding arrangements during training.

content_sections.heading: KRCL Apprentice Trainee Application/ Processing Fee
content_sections.text: The exact processing/examination fee amount is not specified in the provided notification. The notification does describe fee-waiver provisions: candidates from Economically Weaker Sections can submit an income certificate issued by the Tehsildar to seek a fee waiver, and Minority community candidates can submit a self-declaration affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper to claim a fee waiver, in the prescribed formats.

content_sections.heading: KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process
content_sections.text: For all categories, marks obtained across all years/semesters are summed to arrive at an aggregate percentage, and a merit list is prepared accordingly. No rounding off is done, and no weightage is given to any particular semester or year. In case of a tie in marks, the older candidate is preferred; if dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed matriculation earlier is selected. Land loser candidates (as defined in the notification, whose land was acquired for the Konkan Railway Project) are given first preference in selection. Candidates from the districts under KRCL's jurisdiction - Raigad, Ratnagiri and Sindhudurg (Maharashtra), North Goa and South Goa (Goa), and Uttara Kannada, Udupi and Dakshina Kannada (Karnataka) - are given second preference.

content_sections.heading: KRCL Apprentice Trainee Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring the following original documents (as applicable) to Document Verification, along with self-attested photocopies: Semester/year-wise mark sheets along with Degree/Diploma certificate 10th Pass/Matriculation certificate as proof of date of birth Land loser certificate and Tehsildar certificate (for land loser candidates), with supporting RTC land documents and proof of relationship Legal heir and death certificate of the land loser, where applicable Domicile certificate Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) in the Central Government format, and OBC-NCL certificate issued by the Tehsildar, to claim reservation Income and Asset Certificate for EWS category candidates Income certificate from the Tehsildar and Minority Community declaration affidavit, for fee waiver where applicable Gazette notification or legal document for any formal change of name Two attested passport-size photographs Aadhaar card and PAN card A valid, approved NATS ID

faq.question: Q1. What is KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: It is a Special Drive by Konkan Railway Corporation Limited to engage Apprentice Trainees under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS), for 134 posts across engineering and general stream graduate/diploma categories.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in KRCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 134 vacancies are available across BE/Diploma Civil, Electrical, Electronics and Mechanical Engineering, and General Stream Graduates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for KRCL Apprentice Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not prescribe a separate online application deadline. Candidates must have an approved NATS ID and attend Document Verification on their post-wise scheduled date between 24 and 28 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for KRCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BE/B.Tech or Diploma in Civil, Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering, or a graduation degree in a general stream subject (Arts/Science/Commerce/BBA/Management Science/Journalism & Mass Communication/Business Studies), depending on the post, passed out between 2021 and 2025.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KRCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 18 to 25 years as on 1 January 2026, with age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC-NCL candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for KRCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee amount is not specified in the provided notification. Fee-waiver provisions exist for EWS and Minority community candidates on submission of the prescribed certificates/declarations.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for KRCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: By registering on the NATS portal for an approved NATS ID and attending Document Verification with all required original documents on the scheduled date at the Navi Mumbai venue.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for KRCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit list from aggregate marks across all semesters/years, with preference given to land loser candidates first, followed by candidates from KRCL's jurisdiction districts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the stipend for KRCL Apprentice Trainee 2026-27?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices receive Rs. 6,150 per month each from the Government DBT share and the KRCL establishment share; Technician (Diploma) Apprentices receive Rs. 5,450 per month each from both shares.
